passage:
Dex has a pet hen. 
The hen is big and red. 
Dex let his hen run. 
But the hen ran into a pig pen.

The hen has a big welt. 
Dex must tend to his red hen. 
He gets the hen in its bed. 
“You must rest,” Dex said.
